entities.summary: Arthur Mitchell Sackler was an American psychiatrist and marketer of pharmaceuticals whose fortune originated in medical advertising, profits from drug sales, and trade publications. He was also an art collector. He was one of the three patriarchs of the controversial Sackler family.
